name: Emeria (goddess)
description: A merfolk and kor sky goddess, now understood to reflect Emrakul.

timeline.summary: Iona keeps explorers from climbing too high, knowing Emeria the goddess was a fiction yet believing faith sustained her followers.
timeline.quote: Iona knew the truth—that the goddess Emeria was a fiction—but believed that faith in Emeria sustained her followers through the perils of Zendikar.
